#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

MODELS=(
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-GatedDeltaNet-pure-baseline"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-GatedDeltaNet-New-hybrid-24-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-12-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-6-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-HGRN2-pure-baseline"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-24-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-12-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-6-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-3-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-RetNet-hybrid-24-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-RetNet-hybrid-12-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-RetNet-hybrid-6-1"
  "m-a-p/1.3B-20B-RetNet-hybrid-3-1"
)

LOGFILE="/root/download_log.txt"
echo "=== Download started at $(date) ===" > "$LOGFILE"

total=0
success=0
failed_list=""

for model in "${MODELS[@]}"; do
  dirname=$(basename "$model")
  target="/root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/$dirname"
  total=$((total + 1))

  if [ -f "$target/config.json" ]; then
    echo "=== SKIP $dirname (already exists) ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
    success=$((success + 1))
    continue
  fi

  echo "=== [$total/13] DOWNLOADING $model at $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
  start_time=$(date +%s)

  if huggingface-cli download "$model" --local-dir "$target" 2>&1 | tail -5; then
    end_time=$(date +%s)
    elapsed=$((end_time - start_time))

    if [ -f "$target/config.json" ]; then
      size=$(du -sh "$target" | cut -f1)
      echo "=== OK: $dirname | Size: $size | Time: ${elapsed}s ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
      success=$((success + 1))
    else
      echo "=== FAILED (no config.json): $dirname ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
      failed_list="$failed_list $dirname"
    fi
  else
    echo "=== DOWNLOAD ERROR: $dirname, retrying... ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
    sleep 5
    if huggingface-cli download "$model" --local-dir "$target" 2>&1 | tail -5; then
      if [ -f "$target/config.json" ]; then
        size=$(du -sh "$target" | cut -f1)
        echo "=== OK (retry): $dirname | Size: $size ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
        success=$((success + 1))
      else
        echo "=== FAILED (retry, no config.json): $dirname ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
        failed_list="$failed_list $dirname"
      fi
    else
      echo "=== FAILED (retry error): $dirname ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
      failed_list="$failed_list $dirname"
    fi
  fi
done

echo "" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "=== Download finished at $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "Success: $success/13" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
if [ -n "$failed_list" ]; then
  echo "Failed:$failed_list" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
fi

echo "" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "=== Disk usage ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
df -h /root/autodl-tmp/ | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "=== All 20B models ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/ | grep "20B" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "=== Model sizes ===" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
du -sh /root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/*20B* 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
echo "DONE" | tee -a "$LOGFILE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/download_models.sh
echo "Script created"
tmux send-keys -t download 'bash /root/download_models.sh' Enter && echo "Download started in tmux session"
